name: Competitor Watch - Monthly Client Digest
description: Monthly competitor monitoring. Watches competitor websites per client, detects what changed since last month, scores materiality, and builds a per-client digest.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: "claude-sonnet-5", max_tokens: 6000, messages: [ { role: "user", content: $json.scoring_prompt } ] }) }}

parameters.content:
## Watchlist, not a news firehose

The agency works with one firm per practice area per market, so every client has a known, finite competitor set. That turns an unbounded news problem into a bounded monitoring problem: watch these ten firms, not the internet.

The strongest signal is the competitor own website. Awards, new attorneys, new practice areas, published verdicts and rebrands all appear there first, and it needs no API key.

## Signal ratio is the metric

Most website changes are routine copy edits. The materiality bar exists so the digest stays worth opening.

If material_findings approaches changes_detected, the bar is too low. A monthly digest nobody reads is worse than no digest.
